name: International CSRC Investment Holdings Co., Ltd.
summary: International CSRC Investment Holdings Co., Ltd. produces and sells carbon black for tire and other rubber products in Asia, the United States, and internationally. The company provides carbon black products which are used in plastics, printing and coatings, and conductive applications. It also engages in biotechnology research and development activities. In addition, the company provides investment and consultation services; and produces and sells carbon masterbatch and carbon black. The company was formerly known as China Synthetic Rubber Corporation and changed its name to International CSRC Investment Holdings Co., Ltd. in October 2018.
